styleLock.backgroundSystem: 两套背景严格交替，不得混用第三套：(a) 真实湿区墙角，大规格瓷质墙砖 #D9E1E2 配 2mm 砖缝 #C3CDCE、同系地砖 #C6D0D1，砖格透视线在整幅画内保持几何一致、横缝随纵深均匀收敛，画内至少有一处真实收边件（地漏、挡水条或淋浴屏金属边）交代尺度；(b) 平面信息底板，冷瓷 #E9EDEE 与墨青 #17252A 条带交替，承载直角白卡 #FFFFFF、浅瓷图槽 #E3E9EA 与一枚 1px 描边方形标签。禁止无缝白色棚、禁止重复铺贴的砖纹或复制物体、禁止第二支强调色、禁止把湿区拍成泳池或温泉
styleLock.lightingSystem: 单一光源逻辑贯穿整套：6500K 冷调日光从画外右上方高窗进入，作为右前主光，左侧由瓷砖做低位反弹补光，一道浅角度掠光沿门缝、木口拉手段与封边线滑过以交代构造，接触阴影必须真实落在同一方向，柜体四脚与壁挂箱体都不得悬空漂浮；全片只允许这一个光向，禁止暖色灯具作为主光、禁止湿区内出现灯具或插座、禁止任何带电部件与水接触的画面、禁止逆光剪影与硬长投影
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 产品表面按参考图本真呈现：哑光漆面门板与抽屉面 #222427 带细微橘皮与真实指痕反光衰减，木口台面前沿与横向拉手段 #C79B68 只作饰面呈现、不写树种、不做木纹放大卖点，瓷质台面与台下盆 #F2F3F1 为高光釉面（受控长条高光、非镜面反射），拉丝金属龙头与侧挂杆 #B4BABD 用掠射光读出演伸方向，镜面门为真实反射（只反射对面砖墙与毛巾，绝不反照人物），地面为哑光瓷质砖 #C6D0D1
styleLock.typography: 现代几何无衬线中文字体单一家族，仅 light 与 regular 两档字重并加宽字距；标题一至两行 30-40pt，浅色场用 #222B2E、墨青场用 #EFF3F4，下方一道湖青 #58A9A0 细线；副标 16-20pt、标签 12-15pt；所有画面内文字一律以 「」 包裹的占位符出现，禁止复刻源页文案；每屏渲染字符不超 50，禁止密集正文与小字条款
styleLock.iconSystem: 1.4 单位单线图标，圆角转折，浅色场上只用湖青 #58A9A0、墨青场上只用 #EFF3F4，每个图标坐在 1px 方形描边框内（4px 圆角），每屏最多六枚；禁止实心圆片图标、禁止等轴测插画、禁止立体徽章与长投影、禁止混合线宽
styleLock.presentationRules: 整套内保持与参考图完全一致的门扇数量与宽度分配、右侧抽屉列的抽屉数与哑光面／木口面交替节奏、台面下方的横贯木口抽屉带、嵌入式拉手缺口轮廓（不加任何外凸把手）、四支锥形落地支脚的位置与收分、侧向挂杆与其销钉数量、台下盆在台面上的偏置方向与盆体长方轮廓、单柄龙头的开孔位置、以及上方三门镜柜的黑框比例与柜顶木口压条；实景镜头竖线全部校正、砖缝透视一致；每幅实景都放一件真实五金或洁具（地漏、毛巾杆、淋浴屏边、标准毛巾）作尺度锚点；水只允许以盆内一层浅水膜或单颗水珠出现，绝不把水泼在地面或柜脚周围做演示；壁挂或落地结构必须画出真实固定件；人物只允许无面部、无全身的匿名手部以下裁切，且不得有儿童攀爬拉开的抽屉

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent cool wet-room porcelain-and-ink bathroom vanity and mirror-cabinet ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page set; fixed palette of porcelain info field #E9EDEE, ink-petrol dark field and band #17252A, ink type #222B2E and one aquamarine accent #58A9A0, with the product's own surfaces held constant as matte lacquered fronts #222427, timber-tone trim and pull band #C79B68, glazed ceramic counter and basin #F2F3F1, brushed metal tapware and slide #B4BABD; cool temperature throughout, no warm filter, no colour cast; background system alternates only a real wet-room corner in large-format porcelain wall tile #D9E1E2 with 2mm joints #C3CDCE over matching porcelain floor tile #C6D0D1, where every tile perspective line stays geometrically consistent and at least one real fitting (floor drain, shower screen edge, towel bar or standard towel) anchors scale, and a flat infographic field of porcelain #E9EDEE and ink-petrol #17252A bands carrying square-cornered #FFFFFF cards, one light-porcelain image well #E3E9EA and 1px outlined square label pills; never a white cyclorama, never a repeated tile motif, never a second accent hue; lighting system is one 6500K cool daylight key entering high from camera right through an off-frame window with a low bounce off the porcelain tile on the shadow side, one shallow grazing pass along every drawer seam, pull band and edge line, honest single-direction contact shadows so the legs and the carcass never float, the same single light direction reused in every frame, no warm practical lamp as key, no lamp, socket or live fitting shown inside the wet zone or touching water; surface system renders matte lacquered fronts #222427 with real micro orange-peel falloff, the timber-tone trim #C79B68 as a finish band only with no species named, glazed ceramic #F2F3F1 with one controlled elongated specular streak rather than a mirror, brushed metal #B4BABD read with raking light, and mirror doors that reflect only the opposite tiled wall and a towel, never a person; typography is one modern geometric sans-serif family at light and regular weights with widened tracking, headline 30-40pt in #222B2E on light and #EFF3F4 on ink-petrol with one hairline aquamarine rule beneath, subtitle 16-20pt, labels 12-15pt, every in-image string a 「」-wrapped placeholder, under 50 rendered characters per screen, no dense body copy; icon system is 1.4-unit monoline pictograms with rounded joins in aquamarine #58A9A0 on light fields and #EFF3F4 on ink-petrol fields, each seated in a 1px hairline square outline, maximum six per screen, no filled discs, no isometric illustration, no 3D badges, no mixed stroke weights; product presentation keeps the identical door-leaf count and width split, the drawer column count and its matte-versus-trim front alternation, the full-width trim drawer band under the counter, the recessed pull notch with nothing protruding, the four tapered leg positions, the side rail and its peg count, the offset rectangular undermount basin outline, the single-lever mixer position and the three-door mirror cabinet with its dark frame and timber-tone top cap, all verticals corrected, tile geometry consistent, scale anchored by a real fitting, water allowed only as a shallow film inside the bowl or one droplet, never poured against a cabinet base, wall-mounted units always drawn with their visible fixings, no child on any open drawer; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no changed cabinet layout or added hardware, no timber species or board grade, no E0 or ENF or formaldehyde figure, no waterproof rating or immersion test, no load or dimension figure, no mirror glass spec, no warranty year or certificate, no brand marks, store names, QR codes or price wording.
